purpose: Test whether the one-state terminal storage enrichment rejected under the naive B6 average-to-potential closure becomes informative when its local boundary gradient is reconstructed mass-consistently without fit.
hypothesis: B6 failed because psi(mean(theta)) is not a boundary-gradient preserving map even in a short terminal band. The terminal storage Wt may nevertheless carry the required local information if it is mapped to a mass-consistent local suction slope rather than to psi(theta_bar).

local_shape_reconstruction.slope_solution: unique nonnegative root by deterministic bracket expansion and bisection
local_shape_reconstruction.hydrostatic_property: For exact hydrostatic terminal storage, a_t=1 and qH=0 up to frozen quadrature/root tolerance.
local_shape_reconstruction.role: No-fit physically constrained state-to-gradient reconstruction, not a profile claim.

projection_authority.Wt_source: same conservative Reference terminal-band projection qualified technically in BC2-B6
projection_authority.H_source: qualified BC2-A2 strict interior zero-pressure crossing
projection_authority.widths: frozen in BC2-B6 before its response

comparators: POINT_2_5CM B4 full-order diagnostic context only
time_alignment: Trapezoidal average of candidate endpoint qH values versus accepted interval-average Reference qH, identical to B4-B6.

adjudication.support_rule: A frozen width supports the enriched terminal state only if qH_TERM_LINEAR has lower RMS and mean-absolute error than both MOVING_LAYER_AVERAGE and global LINEAR_STORAGE and no greater sign-mismatch count than either in both WATER_TABLE_RISING and WATER_TABLE_FALLING strata.
adjudication.hold_rule: The same width must be noninferior to global LINEAR_STORAGE in HOLD on RMS, mean-absolute error and sign mismatch.
adjudication.b6_recovery_rule: The candidate must strictly improve RMS and mean-absolute error over the same-width B6 TERMINAL_AVERAGE in both moving strata and HOLD.
adjudication.width_selection_rule: A preferred width is declared only when it is component-wise minimum or tied minimum for RMS and mean-absolute error in WATER_TABLE_RISING, WATER_TABLE_FALLING and HOLD among all supported widths. Otherwise support may be positive with width unresolved.
adjudication.point_gap_rule: POINT_2_5CM remains diagnostic-only. B7 need not match it to receive support.

future_if_supported.next_question: Derive and test the exact moving-control-volume evolution equation for Wt with both boundaries H-d and H moving together, before propagating any reduced dynamics.
